name: Exp_AbsolutelyNoLagLwma
summary: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on the Absolutely No Lag LWMA (Linear Weighted Moving Average) indicator, generating buy and sell signals when the indicator line crosses above or below its signal line. It operates systematically by opening positions on crossover signals and includes configurable lot sizing, stop loss, and take profit parameters for risk management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于 Absolutely No Lag LWMA（无滞后线性加权移动平均线）指标实现趋势跟踪策略，当指标线上穿或下穿信号线时产生买入和卖出信号。它通过交叉信号系统性地开仓，并包含可配置的手数、止损和止盈参数用于风险管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于 Absolutely No Lag LWMA 指标，该指标通过对线性加权移动平均线进行特殊算法处理来尽量消除滞后性，从而更敏锐地捕捉趋势变化。入场条件为当 NoLag LWMA 线上穿信号线时开多单，下穿信号线时开空单，本质上是一个移动平均线交叉策略的改进版本。出场条件依赖可配置的止损和止盈参数，也可能在反向信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户通过输入参数设定交易量，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面缺乏复合资金管理策略，没有根据账户余额或风险比例自动调整仓位大小的功能。整体策略逻辑清晰简单，但依赖单一指标信号，缺乏多维度确认和过滤机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Absolutely No Lag LWMA indicator, which applies a specialized algorithm to the Linear Weighted Moving Average to minimize lag, thereby capturing trend changes more sensitively. Entry conditions trigger a buy when the NoLag LWMA line crosses above its signal line, and a sell when it crosses below, essentially functioning as an improved moving average crossover system. Exit conditions rely on configurable stop loss and take profit parameters, and may also close positions when a reverse signal appears. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user sets the trade volume through an input parameter, with no dynamic position adjustment mechanism. Money management lacks a compounding strategy, as there is no functionality to automatically adjust position size based on account balance or risk percentage. The overall strategy logic is clear and simple, but relies on a single indicator signal without multi-dimensional confirmation or filtering mechanisms.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Group TP in points, close all at this profit

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 跟踪止损点数，0表示不使用
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number to distinguish trade instances

pros: 无滞后LWMA指标相比传统移动平均线能更快响应价格变化，减少信号延迟
策略逻辑简单清晰，参数较少，易于理解和调试
基于趋势跟踪原理，在明确趋势行情中能够有效捕捉较大波段利润
pros_en: The No-Lag LWMA indicator responds to price changes faster than traditional moving averages, reducing signal delay
The strategy logic is simple and clear with few parameters, making it easy to understand and debug
Based on trend-following principles, it can effectively capture significant trend moves in clear trending markets
cons: 依赖单一指标信号，在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动率或账户风险自动调整交易规模
止损和止盈默认值为0，若用户未手动设置则意味着不设止损止盈，存在极大风险敞口
cons_en: Relies on a single indicator signal, prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to automatically adjust trade size based on market volatility or account risk
Stop loss and take profit default to 0, meaning no protection if the user does not manually set them, creating significant risk exposure
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，例如要求高一级别趋势方向一致才允许入场，减少虚假信号
添加基于ATR的动态止损止盈和仓位管理，根据市场波动率自动调整风险参数
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, requiring higher-timeframe trend alignment before entry to reduce false signals
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss, take profit, and position sizing to automatically adjust risk parameters based on market volatility

risk_points: 止损止盈默认值为0，用户若忘记设置则交易无保护，面临无限亏损风险
单一指标交叉策略在震荡市中容易频繁开平仓，造成手续费侵蚀和连续亏损
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit default to 0, leaving trades unprotected with unlimited loss risk if the user forgets to set them
Single indicator crossover strategy tends to open and close positions frequently in ranging markets, eroding capital through spreads and consecutive losses

summary_en: This EA implements a trend-following strategy based on the Absolutely No Lag LWMA (Linear Weighted Moving Average) indicator, generating buy and sell signals when the indicator line crosses above or below its signal line. It operates systematically by opening positions on crossover signals and includes configurable lot sizing, stop loss, and take profit parameters for risk management.
